name: Close the app and leave nothing behind
covers: Closing the app, a PowerShell step that cleans up, and the nothingLeft check, which runs the suite's leftovers script

steps.say: Delete its data folder, so the next run starts afresh

look: tools/Find-Leftovers.ps1 is what nothingLeft runs. The runner also runs it before a run, and cleans up when it finds anything.
